items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Well, anyway, we were performing and our friend Sid Catlett came by to see us.

ctx.x: It might have been the Oriental. Well, anyway, we were performing and our friend Sid Catlett came by to see us. He was backstage looking and listening to us while we were performing and I spied him standing backstage, you know, and I kind of waved to him between notes, you know, and it was so good to see him, especially when we took our intermission. We went back and had a good chat with him, you know.
Seemed in good spirits and healthy?
